vanillin.options.enabled.tooltip: Enables optimized rendering for supported entities and block entities. This can reduce CPU overhead in scenes with many supported objects.
vanillin.options.fold.tooltip: Shows or hides per-type renderer options. Search can find options while these lists are collapsed.
vanillin.options.visual.default.tooltip: Uses the recommended renderer for %s and respects compatibility overrides from other mods.
vanillin.options.visual.force_enable.too: Uses CrankShaft's renderer for %s, overriding compatibility recommendations. This may cause rendering issues with other mods.
flywheel.options.backend.tooltip: Selects the renderer used for CrankShaft terrain, entities, and block entities. Automatic chooses a supported backend.
flywheel.options.backend.unavailable: Not available with the current graphics device, graphics backend or shader pack.
flywheel.options.backend.automatic.toolt: Selects a supported renderer for the current graphics backend and shader pack. Recommended for most systems.
flywheel.options.backend.flywheel.off.to: Disables CrankShaft rendering. Terrain, entities, and block entities use their normal Minecraft or Sodium renderers.
flywheel.options.backend.flywheel.instan: Renders supported objects with OpenGL instancing. Provides broad hardware compatibility but does not use GPU culling.
flywheel.options.backend.flywheel.indire: Uses GPU culling and indirect draw commands to reduce CPU rendering overhead on OpenGL.
flywheel.options.backend.flywheel.gl_mes: Uses NVIDIA mesh shaders to render terrain and supported objects on OpenGL. Performance depends on the GPU and scene.
flywheel.options.backend.flywheel.vk_ind: Uses GPU culling and indirect draw commands with Minecraft's Vulkan graphics backend.
flywheel.options.backend.flywheel.vk_mes: Uses Vulkan mesh shaders to render terrain and supported objects. Performance depends on the GPU and scene.
flywheel.options.backend.flywheel.iris_i: Renders supported objects through the active Iris shader pack using OpenGL instancing.
Uses GPU culling and indirect draw commands while preserving the active Iris shader pack.
flywheel.options.backend.flywheel.iris_m: Uses mesh shaders for terrain rendering through the active Iris shader pack. This experimental option may cause rendering issues.
flywheel.options.backend.flywheel.iris_v: Uses GPU culling and indirect draw commands through the active Iris shader pack on Vulkan.
flywheel.options.light_smoothness.flat.t: Disables interpolation between lighting samples. This is the fastest option but produces sharper lighting transitions.
flywheel.options.light_smoothness.tri_li: Interpolates between nearby lighting samples to reduce abrupt transitions.
flywheel.options.light_smoothness.smooth: Smooths lighting across CrankShaft objects for more consistent shading.
Improves lighting on faces inside blocks. This can reduce artifacts on embedded models at additional GPU cost.
Faster, but overlapping see-through blocks look less accurate.
flywheel.options.shaderpack_oit.deferred: Slower, but overlapping see-through blocks look more accurate.
flywheel.options.layers.tooltip: Controls the layer budget for transparent surfaces. Higher values can improve overlapping transparency at the cost of GPU memory and rendering time. A value of 0 uses the preset.
flywheel.options.exact_weather.tooltip: Includes rain and snow in transparency sorting when Improved Transparency is enabled. This can significantly increase GPU load during weather.
flywheel.options.limit_updates.tooltip: Reduces how often distant objects are updated. This can reduce CPU load, but distant animations may appear less smooth.
flywheel.options.concurrent_extraction.t: Uses worker threads to prepare render states for supported entities and block entities. This can reduce CPU rendering time. Disable this if another mod causes rendering errors.
flywheel.options.worker_threads.tooltip: Sets the number of workers in CrankShaft's dedicated thread pool. Higher values can reduce preparation time, but too many workers may increase CPU contention. One worker runs tasks serially. Requires a game restart.
flywheel.options.common_pool.tooltip: Uses Java's shared thread pool instead of a dedicated pool. This reduces the number of dedicated threads, but work from other mods may delay rendering. Requires a game restart.
command.flywheel.backend.set.unavailable: The requested backend '%s' is not available
command.flywheel.terrain.requires_sodium: Terrain mode %s requires Sodium. The setting was not changed.
command.flywheel.oit.no_insert: No insert OIT mode is active.
command.flywheel.debug.gl_only: OpenGL only; no effect on the active Vulkan backend.
command.flywheel.debug.gpu_timer.armed: GPU timer: armed for one completed frame
command.flywheel.debug.gpu_timer.unavail: GPU timer unavailable on the active backend
No completed GPU timer frame yet.
flywheel.options.preview.fallback: Uses Wavelet because the requested method is unavailable.
flywheel.options.preview.oit.wavelet: Uses approximate order-independent transparency. This supports many overlapping surfaces but may soften boundaries between transparent layers.
flywheel.options.preview.oit.mlab: Preserves up to %s overlapping layers and combines deeper layers. This balances image quality, GPU memory use, and rendering cost.
flywheel.options.preview.oit.kbuffer: Stores up to %s layers per pixel. Additional layers are discarded, which can cause visible errors in dense transparency.
flywheel.options.preview.oit.abuffer: Stores fragments in a shared pool and resolves up to %s layers per pixel. Complex scenes can require more GPU memory and processing time.
flywheel.options.preview.terrain.off: Uses Minecraft or Sodium to render all terrain. Translucent terrain is rendered separately from CrankShaft objects, which can cause incorrect overlap.
flywheel.options.preview.terrain.opaque: Uses GPU culling for opaque terrain. Translucent terrain remains with Minecraft or Sodium, which can cause incorrect overlap with CrankShaft objects.
flywheel.options.preview.terrain.translu: Combines translucent terrain with CrankShaft objects for consistent transparency. Opaque terrain remains with Minecraft or Sodium.
flywheel.options.preview.terrain.full: Uses GPU culling for opaque terrain and combines translucent terrain with CrankShaft objects. This can improve performance in large scenes and correct overlapping transparency.
